prose.text: The chunk's own probes come first, then the library's build, its controls and three local legs, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order (`capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step, the base-identity bindings close, since the chunk adds no procedure), then the local pre-push check, then the operator pass.

The three legs boot the release app on this host under a virtual display. Each moves the receivers to 14317 and 14318 through the two port variables, so the shared ports 4317 and 4318 are never bound; each unsets `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`; each writes a fresh data dir under `target/`, named at invocation. The `boot` verb rebuilds the release binary itself, so the legs read the tree as it stands. A reading taken under heavy host load says so in the evidence.

Absences, each with its reason: - No webview gate and no headful self-verify: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched. - No boot-path smoke gate in test-plan §3's sense: none of its trigger paths is in the modify-set. The three legs   are this chunk's own. - No leg for the `runtime-exit` and `no-record` arms on the real app: nothing makes the app end those ways on   demand. The compiled children of step 4 are their controls, run by the workspace suite. - No Windows leg: nothing runs `scripts/agent-run.ps1` here or in CI. - One targeted nextest entry, and only one: the instrument's own controls run ahead of the three legs that grade   with it. Step 1 runs the suite as the red-before-green pair; the workspace entry runs every test on every   re-run.

On the untouched tree the build entry and the three legs read red: the source, the member and the verb do not exist yet. The control leg carries no exit atom, since `xvfb-run` itself returns non-zero when its display server is already gone; its `contains` atoms decide it. Its two library-name atoms are this host's reading (`p3-measurements.md`, the control table).

The files a CI run keeps (`logs/exit-witness.jsonl`, `logs/boot-series.json`, `logs/series/boot-{ordinal}/`) are produced by that run, a step outside this block; the operator pass's download entries read them and carry no `artifact`.

**The operator pass, in this order** (inputs#I3). 1. The hygiene entry, the pre-CI commit, the local pre-push check, then the build-branch push. 2. The CI read of the pushed tip, whole, **report-only**. It is attempt 1 and **it is the chunk's CI verdict**,    whatever is read after it. It may end either way: a self-end in any of the eight boots reds the job, which is    the defect staying visible. 3. Three report-only reads of that run by its id: the jobs of attempt 1; the `boot` job's log lines that carry the    verdicts; the run's `logs-boot-Linux` artifact, downloaded under `target/`, with `boot-series.json`, the    smoke's settle verdict and every `exit-witness.jsonl` printed. 4. **Each kept witness file is read whole.** A line holding an environment value, a path beyond a basename, a    secret-class value or anything of a watched service's telemetry stops the pass, and the operator is told. 5. **The stop at a self-end.** If any boot of an attempt reads `ended`, the pass stops re-running and says what the    job kept for that boot: its ordinal, its exit record, its `exit_witness` label and its witness lines whole.    Naming the cause from them is the report's; nothing is fixed on top. 6. **When attempt 1 holds no self-end.** The instrument's green reading is recorded first (eight boots, each    `exit_witness: loaded`, each boot's times against the earlier green runs'). Then, on the operator's word    (inputs#I3): the `boot` job alone is re-run on the same commit, at most three times. Before each re-run the    attempt just read is recorded with its number and its artifact is already downloaded. Every attempt is recorded    with its number and none replaces another. The pass stops at the first attempt that holds a self-end, or after    the third re-run. 7. **When four attempts hold no self-end.** The pass ends and the report says so as a reading: no self-end in 32    boots, four of them first boots, under the instrument, against two red in six runs without it. It names no    cause and does not say the instrument or the series removed it.
Evidence files are written by /implement and by the operator pass from the entries' recorded outputs; no entry writes one.
